events.title: Long Trip Is Joining Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Long Trip is officially joining Steam Next Fest from October 19–26!Explore eerie dungeons, ride wolves across vast deserts, take flight on a dragon, and challenge towering colossal bosses in a single-player dark fantasy VR action RPG.The free PCVR demo is already live, and a major new update has just arrived—there’s no need to wait for the festival to begin your adventure!🎮 Try the demo now, share your thoughts, and add Long Trip to your Wishlist if you’d like to follow our journey!🔗 Steam Store
